vulnerabilities.description: Unbounded protobuf varint decoding. Loop `do { b = bytes[i++]; v += (b & 0x7f) * 2 ** s; s += 7; } while (b & 0x80)` has no bounds check on array index `i` or iteration count. Malformed message with excessive continuation bytes causes buffer overread or hang.
vulnerabilities.cve: CWE-680: integer overflow to buffer overflow (varint unbounded)

vulnerabilities.description: Custom XML parser without recursion depth limit. parseElement() recurses without guarding max depth. Deeply nested XML (500+ levels) exhausts stack.
buildSetTargetPower() packs watts to int16 (range -32768..32767) without bounds check. Negative or oversized power silently truncates/corrupts message.
zoneChip() embeds color parameter directly in inline style without validation: style="--accent:${color}". Malicious color like 'red; --backdoor:x' injects CSS properties.
vulnerabilities.cve: CWE-94: improper control of generation of code (CSS injection)

vulnerabilities.description: Writer.value() silently clamps oversized values instead of raising error. Power/HR data corruption masked by silent truncation.
vulnerabilities.cve: CWE-393: return of wrong status code

scoreReasoning: Three medium-severity parsing/bounds vulns (protobuf varint, XML recursion, numeric overflow) + low-severity CSS/data-loss issues. Bike module isolated from auth/plan engine. No crypto/auth bypass, no code injection. Mitigations: add bounds checks to parsing loops, validate numeric ranges, sanitize CSS values.
recommendations: HIGH: Protobuf varint bounds. zwift-ride.js line 48: add maxBytes=5 check. throw if i >= bytes.length before reading.
HIGH: XML recursion depth. workouts.js: add depth param to parseElement(). fail if depth > 50.
HIGH: Numeric bounds validation. trainer.js buildSetTargetPower/buildSetSimGrade: clamp watts [0,3000], grade [-10,25].
MEDIUM: CSS injection prevention. view.js zoneChip(): validate color against /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$|^rgb\(|^hsl\(/ or use CSS custom property map instead of string interpolation.
MEDIUM: FIT value overflow handling. fit.js Writer.value(): throw on overflow instead of silent truncation. Let caller decide scaling.
LOW: localStorage namespace collision. ns.js: use crypto.getRandomValues() instead of location.pathname for namespace suffix if path is mutable.
Process: Fuzzing: test XML parser with nested 500 levels, protobuf decoder with malformed varints (100+ continuation bytes).
affectedModules: web/bike/ (zwift-ride.js protobuf, workouts.js XML, trainer.js numeric packing, view.js CSS, fit.js truncation)
unaffected: src/paceforge/ (Python — no parsing or I/O vectors exposed)
web/bike/upload.js (tokens in sessionStorage only, ephemeral per CLAUDE.md)
web/bike/hr.js (sensor data passthrough, no untrusted input)
positive_practices: Session tokens ephemeral: upload credentials in sessionStorage only, cleared on browser close
Web Bluetooth permissioned: navigator.bluetooth.requestDevice() requires explicit user consent
No SQL: file-based storage, zero SQL injection surface
Env secrets: API tokens in ~/.config/paceforge/env (0600), not in code or .env files
testCoverage: Protobuf: decodeControllerNotification() with 100-byte varint continuation sequence
auditScope: web/bike/*.js, .env.example, fit.js, trainer.js, upload.js, view.js, workouts.js, zwift-ride.js. Excludes third-party deps (.venv/).
summary: Bike module has 5 parsing/bounds vulnerabilities, all contained in isolated web components. No auth bypass, crypto flaw, or data corruption risk. Fixes: add loop bounds to varint decoder, recursion guard to XML parser, range checks to trainer control, CSS validator to view, overflow handling to FIT encoder. Risk: low-to-moderate; isolated to rides/workouts feature.
